messages.author: 92ebcee08aef94c4
messages.subject: HELP: invalid class “lavaan” object
parts:
Hi all,

I ran into the error below when I am running my model. What does the error mean? When I am using FIML to handle the missing data, the results came back just fine.


> SEMdeprdel <- sem(SEMdepr,data=analynanew, missing ="listwise")
Error in validObject(.Object) : 
  invalid class “lavaan” object: 1: invalid object for slot "ParTable" in class "lavaan": got class "lavaan.data.frame", should be or extend class "list"
invalid class “lavaan” object: 2: invalid object for slot "ParTable" in class "lavaan": got class "data.frame", should be or extend class "list"

messages.author: 839a14ba8eb0d4a0
messages.subject: Re: HELP: invalid class “lavaan” object
parts:
Hi all,

I was having the same problem when trying to conduct
measurementInvariance

and
measurementInvarianceCat

but found a workaround. My R-version is 3.5.0.

I fixed it by previously running the commands:
setOldClass("lavaan.data.frame")
setOldClass("data.frame")


However, it only worked for measurementInvariaceCat.

Cheers,
Pedro

I was having the same problem when trying to conduct

and

Make sure you have the latest software.  I can run those examples from the help pages without any error, using R 3.5.0, lavaan 0.6-1, and the latest development version of semTools (0.4-15.930).  If you have the devtools package installed, you can install the development version of semTools using 

devtools::install_github("simsem/semTools/semTools")
